title: Bobby's Triple Threat
description:
S03 E05 — Titans vs. Silvia Barban
Chef Silvia Barban has one thing on her mind, and that's sweet revenge; Brooke Williamson has beaten Silvia in the past, and it's still on her mind! If she can handle the hurdles of Bobby Flay's Triple Threat kitchen, she just may taste it.

title: Bobby's Triple Threat
description:
S05 E11 — Titans vs Katianna Hong
Chef Katianna Hong works her culinary magic against the Titans.

title: Bobby Flay's the Line
description:
S01 E09 — Einat Admony: Balaboosta
Longtime competitor Einat Admony is spicing up the kitchen in a Middle Eastern matchup with Bobby Flay's home team.

title: Bobby's Triple Threat
description:
S04 E05 — Titans vs. Maneet Chauhan
Chef Maneet Chauhan throws down her gauntlet to win $25,000 against Bobby Flay's Titans; after losing to Maneet twice on Tournament of Champions, Brooke Williamson is ready to defend her home court; chef Charlie Mitchell doles out tough critiques.

title: Bobby's Triple Threat
description:
S03 E05 — Titans vs. Silvia Barban
Chef Silvia Barban has one thing on her mind, and that's sweet revenge; Brooke Williamson has beaten Silvia in the past, and it's still on her mind! If she can handle the hurdles of Bobby Flay's Triple Threat kitchen, she just may taste it.

title: Bobby's Triple Threat
description:
S01 E01 — Titans vs. Jonathon Sawyer
Heavy hitting chef Jonathon Sawyer fights for his life against Bobby Flay's Titans; one chef risks it all by making pasta for legendary Italian chef and judge Nancy Silverton.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S14 E13 — Fall Brunch Strikes Back
Sunny Anderson makes Funky Monkey Bread Pudding; Jeff Mauro and Katie Lee share recipes for Pancake Tacos; adding new flavors to amp up oatmeal; Chef Meny Vaknin serves Mediterranean Eggs; Geoffrey Zakarian serves Apple Cider Brunch Punch.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S36 E04 — Weeknight Winners: Kitchen Tools Edition
The Kitchen rethinks kitchen tools to make a week's worth of easy dinners; Katie Lee Biegel makes slow cooker pulled pork tacos, Geoffrey Zakarian whips up a quick pasta amatriciana and Sunny Anderson steams up garlic ginger chicken dumplings.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S38 E11 — Kitchen Rules
The Kitchen is sharing essential rules for culinary success, including how to cook pork, seafood and a classic omelet. Plus, special guests Bryon Gomez and Nini Nguyen from Food Network's Hot List 2025 stop by to share their own cooking rules.

title: Bobby's Triple Threat
description:
S05 E01 — Titans vs. Alex Stupak
Titan Michael Voltaggio is left speechless when his longtime friend Alex Stupak enters Bobby Flay's Triple Threat kitchen; this culinary rebel is ready to annihilate the Titans and win the glory, but Michelin-star chef Buddha Lo is the judge of that.

title: Bobby's Triple Threat
description:
S05 E03 — Titans vs. Competition Legend
It's the shock heard round the culinary world as Bobby Flay calls a dear friend to triple threat under false pretenses, and his surprise has the Titans shook; Italian culinary maestro Stefano Secchi holds all the cards.

title: Bobby's Triple Threat
description:
S05 E05 — Titans vs. Kenny Gilbert
Titan Michael Voltaggio's former mentor Kenny Gilbert is here to claim a spot on the Titans' couch. His Southern-inspired global dishes do impress James Beard Award-winning chef Nina Compton, but are they enough to secure the win?

title: Bobby's Triple Threat
description:
S05 E11 — Titans vs Katianna Hong
Chef Katianna Hong works her culinary magic against the Titans.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S41 E03 — Extreme Express Lane
In the most extreme express lane challenge ever, Guy Fieri gives three all-star chefs one hour to make an upscale appetizer, entrée, and dessert using a total of only 12 ingredients! The winner gets to shop Flavortown Market for up to $20,000.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S42 E10 — Firefighters & All-Star Friends
Fieri invites firefighters to partner with all-star chefs for a special team competition; the firefighters and their all-star sous chefs make a 20-minute firehouse breakfast to win $2,500, followed by a complete firehouse dinner to win up to $20,000.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S42 E11 — GGG Callouts
Guy Fieri invites two of GGG's winningest chefs to call out the all-star chefs who played a part in their unexpected loss for a shot at winning $10,000; Laura Fonner takes on judge Aarti Sequeira and Crista Luedtke calls out Stephanie Izard.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S15 E05 — DDD Holiday Showdown
Guy gives the chefs gift boxes containing ingredients they must use in their holiday ham dish; they receive stockings filled with sweets and treats that must be included in their family holiday dinner.

title: Guy's Grocery Games
description:
S22 E12 — GGG Holiday Cook-Off
Four charitable chefs compete in a holiday cook-off; Guy hands out gifts of special ingredients that the chefs must feature in their holiday pork dish; he uses a dreidel to give the chefs their budgets for a festive family favorite.

title: Beat Bobby Flay: Holiday Throwdown
description:
S03 E02 — Pie in the Sky
Ina Garten passes the whipped cream as she recruits chefs Amanda Freitag, Aarti Sequeira and Duff Goldman to serve Bobby Flay a slice of humble pie; in each round, these chefs bake up an ode to everyone's favorite Thanksgiving dessert.

title: Beat Bobby Flay: Holiday Throwdown
description:
S02 E05 — Feeling Frosted
Sunny Anderson sprinkles holiday cheer with sugar, spice and everything nice; Chefs Stephanie Izard, Damaris Phillips and Duff Goldman challenge Bobby Flay to a baking battle as they whip up some frosted treats in a bid to leave Bobby iced out.

title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking
description:
S03 E01 — Memorable Firsts and Magic
James and Oliver challenge the teams to create cakes inspired by the first Harry Potter movie and their favorite spells; the showpieces are delivered to the Quidditch pitch and Ollivander's Wand Shop for judging by Duff Goldman and Sarah Mountain.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S13 E01 — Welcome to Santa's Workshop
Host Palmer divides the 12 bakers into two teams and challenges them to make holiday stained-glass cakes; Judges Duff Goldman, Kardea Brown and Molly Yeh decide the winner of a $1,000 prize package, and one baker from the losing team is eliminated.

title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking

title: Bake It 'Til You Make It
description:
S01 E01 — Dashing Through the Snow, With My Competition Cake
At the National Capital Area Cake Show, a winter wonderland theme pushes competitors to show off their holiday best in cake or cookie form; bakers deal with last-minute damages, finicky judges and fierce competition to reach the podium.

title: Selena + Chef: Home for the Holidays
description:
S01 E03 — Selena + Claudette
Selena Gomez and Chef Claudette Zepeda prepare a Mexican feast for the holidays. Claudette takes Selena back to her roots with a festive menu of Tamales, Roast Ham with Salsa Macha, Charred Poblano Rice and a Mexican twist on a historic salad.

title: Selena + Chef: Home for the Holidays
description:
S01 E02 — Selena + Michael
It's a surf-and-turf Christmas Eve as Michael Symon joins Selena Gomez. They tackle a menu of Smoked and Reverse-Seared Steaks plus luxurious Lobster with Homemade Pasta, while an Escarole Salad challenges Selena to overcome a mental block.

title: Selena + Chef: Home for the Holidays
description:
S01 E01 — Selena + Alex
Selena Gomez welcomes chef Alex Guarnaschelli to help with a meal for her tree-trimming party; they prepare a feast of fried mozzarella sticks and creamy marinara, Chantilly mashed potatoes, black pepper roast beef and chocolate candy cane bark.

title: Santa's Baking Blizzard
description:
S01 E03 — Countdown to Christmas
Casey Webb challenges three teams of Christmas bakers and their ice sculptors to create colossal Christmas tree cake displays complete with edible presents, ornaments and pyrotechnics.

title: Santa's Baking Blizzard
description:
S01 E01 — Winter Wonderland
Casey Webb challenges three teams of Christmas bakers to create fantasy snow globe cakes that capture the magic and joy of the holidays; each team uses ice sculpture to enhance the glitz and glam of their display and impress the judges.

title: Santa's Baking Blizzard
description:
S01 E02 — Mrs. Claus' Night Off
Casey Webb challenges three teams of master holiday bakers and their ice sculptors to show off a new side of Santa's better half in out-of-this-world cake designs and displays.

title: Santa's Baking Blizzard
description:
S01 E04 — Santa's Christmas Eve
The three remaining baking teams and their ice sculptors must create the ultimate "Night Before Christmas" cake display featuring Santa.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S05 E04 — Holiday Parade
The six remaining teams face off as Jeff Mauro tasks them with creating the holiday tradition of a parade float; judges Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira decide which team has the most festive float and who drives home.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S05 E05 — Christmas Card Craziness
Jeff Mauro challenges the teams to create a scene capturing the moment a holiday photo goes wrong, while highlighting their cookie artist skills; judges Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira cut one team out of the picture.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S05 E06 — Christmas Under the Sea
To celebrate "Aquaman and the Lost Kingdom," host Jeff Mauro asks the teams to imagine what holidays look like under the sea and incorporate underwater plant life made entirely of sugar.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S05 E07 — Kids Catch Santa
Jeff Mauro challenges the three remaining teams to reveal what will happen when the kids finally catch Santa while he's delivering their toys.

title: Holiday Wars
description:
S05 E08 — Holiday Light Show
The last two teams standing take Christmas light displays to the next level by creating large-scale illuminated structures; Jeff Mauro, Shinmin Li and Aarti Sequeira determine who will be crowned Holiday Wars champion and win the $25,000 prize.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S08 E01 — Christmas on the North Pole Farm
Ree Drummond and Eddie Jackson ask four countrified cookie makers to share how farm animals hoedown for the holidays at the North Pole.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S08 E02 — North Pole Town Square
Ree Drummond and Eddie Jackson ask four competitive cookie makers to tackle two winter sports cookies; after the game, the cookie makers craft their own towering 10-foot tall Christmas gazebos where the merry residents of the North Pole can gather.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S08 E05 — Christmas Feast
Ree Drummond and Eddie Jackson ask four cookie makers to whip up imposter cookies that look just like dishes fit for the North Pole Christmas dinner; it's time for dessert as the cookie makers tackle Christmas cookie pies.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S08 E03 — Gingerbread Experts
Ree Drummond and Eddie Jackson challenge four gingerbreaders to create massive North Pole Christmas market displays out of gingerbread; these gingerbread geniuses will have to pick a festive fruit to incorporate into their cookies.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S08 E07 — Superheroes of Christmas
Ree Drummond and Eddie Jackson task four superpowered cookie makers with creating cookies; the cookie makers design outlandish vehicles for their superheroes to steer.

title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
description:
S08 E08 — Christmas on the Go
Ree Drummond and Eddie Jackson rev their engines as they ask four cookie makers to create cookie billboards; the cookie makers celebrate with their own edible trains.

title: Carnival Eats
description:
S04 E25 — 'Tis the Season
Some favorite holiday dishes get the Carnival Eats treatment; Noah gets a Taste of Christmas in Pennsylvania; Noah discovers a To Die For Casserole in Michigan.

title: Carnival Eats
description:
S03 E15 — Funnel Cakes and Fried Fudge
Noah visits the York Fair in Pennsylvania; savors the Taste of Christmas; Burger Bomb Pretzel; fork-free Chick'n'Waffle; apple pie funnel cake.

title: Tournament of Champions
description:
S06 E06 — The Randomizer Strikes Back
The second-round battles continue as Guy Fieri invites the last of the Super 16 to fight for the remaining four spots in the Great 8.

title: Kids Baking Championship
description:
North Pole Edition
Duff Goldman and Valerie Bertinelli lead eight talented young bakers through tasty challenges designed to find the most impressive and creative baker.

title: Holiday Baking Championship
description:
S13 E01 — Welcome to Santa's Workshop
Host Palmer divides the 12 bakers into two teams and challenges them to make holiday stained-glass cakes; Judges Duff Goldman, Kardea Brown and Molly Yeh decide the winner of a $1,000 prize package, and one baker from the losing team is eliminated.

description:
S03 E01 — Memorable Firsts and Magic
James and Oliver challenge the teams to create cakes inspired by the first Harry Potter movie and their favorite spells; the showpieces are delivered to the Quidditch pitch and Ollivander's Wand Shop for judging by Duff Goldman and Sarah Mountain.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S27 E06 — Ocean Coasts and Great Lakes
In Los Angeles, a Mexican joint in Grand Central Market serves outrageous octopus tostadas and their spin on a burger; in Norfolk, a bistro turns out grown-up, gourmet grilled cheese; a righteous stop in Lansing does it up right.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S28 E02 — Delicious Discoveries
This trip, Guy Fieri uncovers some surprising culinary discoveries; in Columbus, Ohio, a hidden gem tucked away in a grocery store serves out-of-bounds Nepalese-Tibetan specialties.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S29 E08 — Meaty Mashup
In Little Rock, Ark., a gas station-turned-eatery pumps bison into a burrito and piles pork onto cornmeal waffles; in Santa Rosa, Calif., a Vietnamese joint makes pho and barbecue pork; in Sonoma, Calif., a barbecue spot loads up a monster burger.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S30 E01 — Round the World Roundup
In Smyrna, Ga., a doctor-turned-chef fires up amazing Asian from righteous ramen to Korean wings.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S32 E04 — British, Hawaiian and Mexican
Guy grabs grub from all around the globe; in Wilmington, Del., there's a true British pub serving authentic English staples from fish and chips to Yorkshire Pudding; a poke counter is dishing out a Hawaiian classic with an updated twist in Kauai.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S32 E11 — Spinning the Globe
In Kauai, Hawaii, a culinary dojo amping up local specialties like saimin and chili pepper chicken; a twist on tacos and burritos in Kansas City, Mo.; a funky food truck in El Paso, Texas, putting out meatless Mexican that's huge on taste.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S34 E09 — Smokin' Hot BBQ
Guy Fieri's diving into all kinds of 'cue on this trip; in Ottawa, Canada, a funky chicken joint cranking the rotisserie; in Burlington, Vt., a place smokin' their wings; Texas-style spot in Richmond, Va.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S37 E08 — Pierogis, Pork and Pizza
A sandwich shop serving up tastes of Peru in Hollywood, Fla.; a pierogi palace in Philadelphia giving a fresh take on Polish specialties; a wood-fired pizza spot putting its own spin on pies in Fargo, N.D.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S43 E09 — From Chicken to Cheesesteak
Guy Fieri is digging into chicken and some crazy creations; in Palm Springs, Calif., a crêpe spot is all about the savory, while a joint is cooking real deal Mexican pollo; an Egyptian food truck is serving wings and a falafel waffle.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S42 E14 — Chicken, Steak and Cake
Guy Fieri's doubling up with sweet and savory, both hot and cold; there are chicken and steak arepas in San Juan, Puerto Rico, winning wings from a food truck in Laramie, Wyo., and an ice cream-cake combo; a raclette-ramen mashup in Cleveland.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S43 E11 — Stuffed, Smoked and Wrapped
Guy Fieri is pickin' up what Flavortown is puttin' down, starting at a Nashville joint that's adding green chile crunch to their signature wrap; in Florida, two beach spots are smokin' up alligator ribs and serving Venezuelan stuffed specialties.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S45 E04 — Interesting Italian
Guy Fieri is digging into all kinds of Italian; in Santa Barbara, Calif., Dennis Miller's riding shotgun for prime pizza; in Las Vegas, a vegan joint puts its spin on an Italian sandwich; a funky pizzeria stuffs chicken parm into stromboli.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S47 E07 — Meaty to Meatless
Guy Fieri's digging into dishes with and without meat; in Mobile, AL, there's rabbit, while in Omaha, NE, a vegan joint brings a meatless spin to fried chicken; in Stamford, CT, Guy and sportscaster Dan Patrick chow down on Greek.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S49 E11 — Coast-to-Coast Comfort
Guy Fieri digs Greek-style lasagna at a family-run diner in Columbus; a California joint adds flair to comfort food with top-notch chicken and dumplings; big deal BBQ in New Jersey serves up pork and brisket piled high.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S51 E08 — Sauerkraut, Shoyu and Shank
Guy Fieri's grabbing creative flavor combos that pack a punch; a NYC couple is bringing Greek grub to Naples, FL; a Dallas spot is serving over-the-top pork belly lollipops; a Triple-G winner is putting out next-level ramen in Chicago.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S55 E01 — Buns, Burgers and Bolognese
Guy Fieri's digging into pork dumplings from a husband-and-wife team in Sacramento, Calif.; a Palm Beach Gardens, Fla. Bistro is mixing up a meat sauce; a mom-and-pop shop in San Jose, Calif. Serves up black bean burgers.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S56 E09 — Sandwiches, Seafood & Soba Noodles
Guy Fieri's digging into fresh fish, sammies!; in Seattle, a seafood spot is dishing out a rockfish banh mi, and a Japanese joint is serving up soba and decadent duck; plus, there's real-deal BBQ in Tampa, bringing big flavor to the-bomb brisket.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S56 E03 — Beef, Chicken, and Pork
Guy Fieri digs into top meats, from righteous Tampa farm-to-sandwich roast pork to lights-out pastaria lasagna in Bentonville, Ark.; he aslo tries legit family-made noodle bowls in Rogers, Ark.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S53 E09 — Dirty, Crunchy, Sticky and Veggie
Guy Fieri is diving into texture and flavor; a BBQ bistro in Sherman Oaks is cooking the brisket noodles; a Cincinnati diner is plating top-notch chili crunch chicken nuggets; a spot in Austin is serving up a primo pasta margarita.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S51 E11 — Flavortown Finds
Guy Fieri's finding flavor, starting with a Gainesville, Fla., bagel shop serving carrot-style lox on salted rosemary; then a Baton Rouge, La., joint is chargrilling oysters, and a spot in Naples, Fla., is serving prime-time pastrami.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S50 E03 — Burgers, Bone Marrow and Bangladesh
Guy Fieri's grabs big-deal eats; smoking smash burgers at a whisky joint in East Boston; a Minneapolis spot serves up flavor bursting bone marrow; a GGG alumnus dishes out the bomb Bengali-American fare in Ohio.

title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
description:
S48 E12 — From Spicy to Sticky
Guy Fieri savors both spicy and sweet eats; in St. Simons Island, GA, a bomb bakery plates righteous rum cake; a pizza restaurant in Boulder, CO, fires up artisan pies; a spot in San Antonio, Texas, delivers dynamite duck.

title: Carnival Eats
description:
S03 E11 — Clams and Cannoli
Noah visits the Delaware County Fair for Spaghizza; Freshman 15 Fries; Veteran's Clams 'n' Corn; Holy Cannoli.

title: Carnival Eats
description:
S03 E07 — Mac and Cheese and Monster Meat
Noah visits the Great New York State Fair for The Defibrillator, piquant Buffalo chicken mac and cheese, clamwich, and PB&J Ice Cream; a visit to the South Carolina State Fair in Columbia to try The Super Stick, meatball sub and The King's Corn Dog.

title: Girl Meets Farm
description:
S02 E01 — Thanksgiving
Molly hosts Thanksgiving on the farm with Nick, her mom and a variety of family friends; she makes foolproof Sweet-and-Smoky Turkey, Crunchy Pretzel Stuffing, Charred Creamed Corn and Lemon Almond Cake with Cranberry Glaze.

title: Girl Meets Farm
description:
S02 E05 — Apple Harvest
Molly's blogging friends are flying in to help her pick apples on the farm; she makes a campfire supper that includes fried cheesy pickles, a butternut, bacon and apple hot dish, creamed spinach with crispy cheese and creamy butterscotch pudding.

title: Girl Meets Farm
description:
S04 E05 — Wheat Harvest
Molly makes a meal to share with the farmers and keep them fueled for the wheat harvest; cheesy ham, spinach and potato pizzas; tangy tomato green bean salad with wheat berries; coconut pudding with roasted rhubarb.

title: Girl Meets Farm
description:
S06 E05 — Harvest Pre-Haul
Molly Yeh is making the coziest foods imaginable; spiced beef hot dish with bacon jalapeño cornbread; loaded potato skins; for dessert, dreamy tahini fudge pie.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S19 E03 — Feeding Now, Feeding Later
While Ladd feeds cattle and wild horses, Ree makes spicy stewed beef, pimento cheese and bacon grits, and a hearty side of roasted broccoli salad with sour cream and parsley dressing; Ree prepares for a future breakfast with a Mason jar pancake mix.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S24 E10 — Quarterback Mom
Ree Drummond's quarterback teens have a big game coming up, and she's getting ahead by making their favorite food for a post-game dinner.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S32 E09 — Fridge Raid
Ree Drummond is raiding the fridge for some sensational eats; first up, fridge raid shakshuka is a good way to start the day, followed by easy produce drawer primavera; pancake mix dessert crêpes and loaded potato pancakes round out the menu.

title: The Pioneer Woman
description:
S39 E14 — Apps Made Easy
Ree Drummond makes easy, impressive appetizers, starting with Tex-Mex Sausage Balls; Ree prepares Crostini Two Ways, Mini Lemon Raspberry Bundt Cakes with pink frosting, and juicy Ribeye Bites with Horseradish Mustard Aioli that packs a punch.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S34 E09 — Snacks for Dinner
The Kitchen hosts have hearty versions of everyone's favorite snacks; Jeff Mauro makes a light dinner of coconut shrimp salad, Sunny Anderson creates a meal out of an easy egg roll bowl and Geoffrey Zakarian digs into a supersized snack for dessert.

title: The Kitchen
description:
S39 E13 — Tasty Tex-Mex Menu
Katie Lee Biegel whips up queso with garlic lime tortilla chips, Geoffrey Zakarian makes chicken fajitas and Alex Guarnaschelli prepares spinach and mushroom vegetable enchiladas.
